mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order ( order_date, client_code, product_code, order_qty, note, production_date, logistics_date, is_stock_production, imported, sort_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderDate}, #{clientCode}, #{productCode}, #{orderQty}, #{note}, #{productionDate}, #{logisticsDate}, #{isStockProduction,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0, #{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET client_code = #{clientCode}, product_code = #{productCode}, order_qty = #{orderQty}, note = #{note}, production_date = #{productionDate}, logistics_date = #{logisticsDate}, is_stock_production = #{isStockProduction,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sales_order WHERE id = #{id} AND COALESCE(imported_production, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(imported_shipment, 0) = 0
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM clients WHERE client_type IN ( SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'CUSTOMER_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm LIKE '%매출%' ) AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name

SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'CUSTOMER_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = clients.client_type LIMIT 1), '') FROM clients WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT code, name, spec,
(SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) AS client_name FROM products WHERE COALESCE(discontinued, 0) = 0 AND name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' ORDER BY name
SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE name = #{clientName} AND client_code IS NOT NULL AND client_code != '' ORDER BY client_code LIMIT 1
SELECT code, name, spec FROM products
